# HIYAGHAR

> HIYAGHAR (also written HIYA Ghar) is a small, family-run brand from Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India. It makes handcrafted mukhwas (traditional Indian digestive mouth fresheners), tea masala for Indian chai, cold-process handmade soap and Ayurvedic herbal hair oil, in small batches from family recipes. Founded by Priti Shah. Orders ship across India from hiyaghar.com.

- Store: 303, APM Mall Complex, Near Bharat Petrol Pump, Sattadhar Cross Road, Ghatlodiya, Ahmedabad 380061, Gujarat, India
- Phone / WhatsApp: +91 9274443617
- Email: support@hiyaghar.com
- Hours: Monday to Saturday, 10:00 AM to 7:00 PM IST
- Prices are in Indian rupees (INR)

## Shop

- [Mukhwas](https://hiyaghar.com/mukhwas): handcrafted digestive mouth fresheners made from traditional family recipes with natural ingredients
- [Tea Masala](https://hiyaghar.com/tea-masala): aromatic spice blend for making Indian chai at home
- [Handmade Soap](https://hiyaghar.com/handmade-soap): cold-process herbal soap bars made with plant-based ingredients
- [Hair Oil](https://hiyaghar.com/hair-oil): Ayurvedic herbal hair oil with botanical extracts
- [Gift Hampers](https://hiyaghar.com/gift-hampers): gifts by occasion: wedding, birthday, housewarming, festival and corporate
- [Wellness Combos](https://hiyaghar.com/combos): build a box of 3, 4 or 6 products and save 10%, 15% or 20%
